connector_sync_period_check.name: connector_sync_period_check
connector_sync_period_check.value: "connector_sync_runs"."requested_from" is null or "connector_sync_runs"."requested_to" is null or "connector_sync_runs"."requested_to" >= "connector_sync_runs"."requested_from"

optimization_findings_savings_check.name: optimization_findings_savings_check
optimization_findings_savings_check.value: "optimization_findings"."savings_min_minor" is null or "optimization_findings"."savings_max_minor" is null or "optimization_findings"."savings_max_minor" >= "optimization_findings"."savings_min_minor"

provider_connections_external_account_id.name: provider_connections_external_account_idx
provider_connections_external_account_id.where: "provider_connections"."external_account_id" is not null and "provider_connections"."archived_at" is null

provider_connections_credentials_check.name: provider_connections_credentials_check
provider_connections_credentials_check.value: ("provider_connections"."credential_ciphertext" is null and "provider_connections"."credential_iv" is null and "provider_connections"."credential_tag" is null) or ("provider_connections"."credential_ciphertext" is not null and "provider_connections"."credential_iv" is not null and "provider_connections"."credential_tag" is not null)

provider_plan_versions_connection_scope_.name: provider_plan_versions_connection_scope_check
provider_plan_versions_connection_scope_.value: ("provider_plan_versions"."connection_id" is null) or ("provider_plan_versions"."workspace_id" is not null)
